meta.name: Meddle visual system
meta.note: Source of truth for every visual value. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/build-tokens.mjs` to regenerate tokens.css. Never hand-edit tokens.css. References use {path.to.token}. Each token carries `use` (where it applies) and, when non-obvious, `why`.
sources: Meddle Discovery & Strategy presentation template (Figma, 2026), the current deck system: figma.com/design/F5oGU0iiKPWWgMGkZDaA21
Meddle business plan deck (InDesign, Sept 2025), the previous deck generation, sampled pixel values

ink.use: Primary dark. Backgrounds of covers, heroes, CTAs, footers. Text and wordmark on light surfaces.
ink.why: A warm near-black, not #000. It reads as printed ink, not as a screen turned off. The deck's #231f20 is the same intent (100K print black) and should be treated as ink.

paper.use: Text and wordmark on ink. Active nav pill fill. Light-theme surface on the web when concrete is too heavy.
paper.why: Softer than #fff so large reversed type on ink doesn't glare. The site never uses pure white for type.

concrete.use: Default light background for web pages (home Work/Services, Sprints, Contact).
concrete.why: Echoes the raw concrete of the art direction. Gives light sections weight so they don't feel like an empty document.

sheet.use: Warm near-white for reading-heavy document surfaces: column slides, proposals, PDFs, one-pagers.
sheet.why: From the Figma presentation template (column and competitor slides). Dense reading gets the lightest surface. It replaces the business plan's cooler #fbfcfc.

graphite.use: Muted text on light surfaces (labels, meta, the 'traditional agency' column) and rules in decks. Also the dark-slide ghost wordmark at 30% opacity.
graphite.why: 4.48:1 on sheet and 3.26:1 on concrete, so it is a large-text color: 18.66px bold or 24px+. For small secondary text on light surfaces use alpha.ink-75 instead.

ash.why: Sampled from the 2025 deck. On ink it passes AA where graphite does not, so the muted color swaps per surface.

signal.use: The only accent. Text-selection highlight (40% alpha), keyboard focus ring on dark surfaces, and one-off 'live' indicators. Never a fill for buttons, backgrounds, headlines, or the wordmark.
signal.why: Owner decision 2026-09-30: the brand is monochrome and purple is a signal, not a color scheme. A signal only works if it is rare.

legacy.status: retired 2026-09-30. Present in older site SCSS. Do not use in new work.

ink-75.use: Secondary body text on light surfaces.

ink-65.use: Small muted text on light (mono labels, captions, list numbers). 4.7:1 on concrete, where graphite fails.

ink-42.use: Rules on light: bordered lists, section dividers.

ink-10.use: Hairlines on light: structural section tops, image placeholders.

paper-25.use: Placeholder text in fields on ink.

frost.use: Frosted pill fill (nav links, buttons) over imagery or ink.

dark.use: Openings: heroes, covers, CTAs, footers, quote sections. The site's default theme.

light.use: The work: case studies, service lists, pricing, forms on the web.

paper.use: Decks: the cover and most interior slides (Figma template). Solid graphite rules, bold graphite labels.
paper.label: {color.graphite}

sheet.use: Reading-heavy documents: column slides, proposals, PDFs, one-pagers.
sheet.label: {color.graphite}

sans.use: Everything by default: headlines, statements, body, UI.

mono.value: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
mono.use: Uppercase labels only: nav, buttons, meta, captions, footer, tooltips, form labels, section numbers.

serif.use: The interference. Italic 400 for emphasized words (<em>) and for client quotations. Roman only in the oversized bold opening quotation mark. Nothing else.

brand.use: All Inter text: headlines, statements, body.
brand.why: The site sets -.042em on every heading and paragraph. It tightens Inter into something denser and more editorial. 42 recurs in the system (rule opacity .42 too).

italic.use: The Libre Baskerville Italic payoff, sign-off, and quotes.
italic.why: Owner decision 2026-09-30: tighter italic tracking so the payoff sits with the tight Inter around it instead of looking loose beside it.

display.use: Inter at 100px+, where -0.042em starts to collide.
Heroes, deck covers and section titles, the one big line on a page. 50px to 110px.

statement.use: The centered positioning paragraph ('It's time you seized an unfair advantage...'). Medium weight, not bold: it speaks, it doesn't shout. 30px to 48px.

h3.use: Sub-heads, and list items in bordered lists (set those at weight 300). 20px to 32px.

body.use: Default web paragraph (19.2px, medium). In documents set body at weight 400.

label.use: Nav, buttons, meta, footer, tooltips, form labels. 12px to 14.5px.

caption.use: Figure captions, service tags on case-study heroes. 11px.

emphasis.use: Any <em>. Inherits size from its parent. At display sizes paired with weight 900, set to 87% so the serif italic doesn't overpower the sans.

quote.use: Client testimonials and pull quotes: Libre Baskerville Italic at -0.042em (as on the MFO case study). The opening mark is Baskerville Bold roman, oversized.

sm.use: Edge margin for the wordmark and nav (tight to the corner).

4xl.use: Section bottom padding, desktop. Meddle pages breathe.

none.use: Everything that holds content: images, video, cards, fields, chips, deck elements.

pill.use: Things you press to go somewhere: nav links, buttons, tooltips.
pill.why: One shape per job. Pills say 'action'; squares say 'content'.

rule.use: Pair with theme rule color (42% alpha).

hairline.use: Pair with theme hairline color (10% alpha).

frost.use: backdrop-filter on nav and button pills.

glow.use: Hover on the single primary CTA on ink (e.g. 'Book an intro call' band).

blend-difference.use: mix-blend-mode for the wordmark and nav when they sit over video or imagery.

measure.use: Max line length for body copy.

deck.use: Decks, proposals, and one-pagers. See brand/visual/layout.md and templates/deck/.
